notes.title: Patch 1.1Ver
notes.content:
1. A huge shoutout to my man @woosk from Steam group Visual novel, JRPG, Anime. Thank you for your exceptional work correcting the script. 
2. Increased Max Display Speed, up to 60 characters per second. 
3. Added a new feature where you can right-click to hide UI.

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/vnislife
This is the anime fan group woosk and his friends are in, you are more than welcome to join! If you like any of the games we have published so far, you are also welcome to send any of the group's admins a friend invite and to follow the group's curator list.
